request.answer: Whenever you call [`em.flush()`](/api/core/class/EntityManager#flush), the ORM will iterate over the Identity Map, and for each entity it compares the original state with the values that are currently set on the entity. Whenever you fetch an object from the database MikroORM will keep a copy of all the properties and associations inside the `UnitOfWork`. Now whenever you call `em.flush()` MikroORM will iterate over all entities you previously marked for persisting via `em.persist()`.
